title: ABC 5 (Jerusalem Chronicle / Chronicle of the early years of Nebuchadnezzar) — English translation on Livius.org
license: Translation adapted from Grayson 1975 and Glassner 2004; paraphrased only

verification_log.method: Obv. 1–11 Carchemish, Hamath, death of Nabopolassar 8 Abu (15 Aug 605), accession 1 Ululu (7 Sep 605); Obv. 12–20 Hatti campaigns, tribute, Ashkelon; Rev. 11′–13′ capture of "the city of Judah" on 2 Addaru, year 7. Jerusalem/Judah not named for 605/604.

access_notes: Full translation page read (obverse 1–27, reverse 1′–13′). Cuneiform and the printed editions (Wiseman 1956; Grayson 1975; Glassner 2004) were not consulted directly. Julian equivalents on the page follow Parker & Dubberstein.
